metadata.case_name: TSE FUK LIN v. LEE KAI AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: as a result of the accident the plaintiff's left hand suffered amputation of the index, middle and ring finger.
injuries.body_part: left hand (index, middle and ring finger)
source: Mr Wedderburn's report reveals that as a result of the accident the plaintiff's left hand suffered amputation of the index, middle and ring finger. The 5th finger also suffered crushing injuries. Revision amputation of the three fingers was performed at Queen Mary Hospital and the plaintiff was discharged after 2 days.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of two or more fingers at or near base, left hand

injuries.description: The 5th finger also suffered crushing injuries.
source: Mr Wedderburn's report reveals that as a result of the accident the plaintiff's left hand suffered amputation of the index, middle and ring finger. injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

manifestations.description: He assessed his total impairment at 26%.

treatments_received: Revision amputation of the three fingers

losses.description: Pain Suffering and Loss of Amenities
